_comment: Tier-2 for fourc::particle_sph#13, exercising #14 alongside it. Four aborts on two upstream decks: CSF without SURFACETENSIONCOEFFICIENT, CSF with phase2 removed from both the PARTICLES list and the phase maps, CSF added to a virtual-wall deck, and the virtual wall with PARTICLE_WALL_SOURCE removed. STEPS_BEFORE_ABORT=0 across all four logs pins that they all fire at setup. WALLSRC_MESSAGE_NAMES_THE_KEY=no records that the wall-source message names an internal C++ interface and never the input key you are missing. CSF_DECKS_WITHOUT_CONTACTANGLE counts upstream CSF decks that omit STATICCONTACTANGLE and still run, which is how the 'not validated at all' half of the entry is grounded.
